domain: VINTAGE-CHAIN-SHAPE (axis 2: amendment-process structure; conditioning on the PROCESS - chain geometry, depth, cadence - never on corrected values)
title: Targeted-repetition strain: short concentrated-vintage-chain filers, long broad-sweep filers, per-sector net-zero on the death-inclusive cohort, conditioned on last_avail amendment stamps

mechanism.who_is_forced_to_trade_or_slow_to_react: The constrained actor is the issuer-auditor pair resolving whether a reporting problem is contained. Each re-addressal of an already-certified field-period is a compelled act; how those compelled acts DISTRIBUTE across the entity's field set is the audit committee's revealed answer to the question 'is this problem contained or recurring'. The slow-to-react actor is the marginal holder, who attends to earnings headlines and sees only 'more amendments' - a quantity - never the geometry of which fields keep recurring (limited attention), so the repetition pattern is not repriced as it accrues.
mechanism.why_the_process_shape_reveals_state: Two chain geometries with IDENTICAL amendment volume mean different things. Repetition piled on the same few fields (high field-concentration of vintage chains) is the signature of an unresolved, recurring reporting problem being patched over and over: restatement strain persists, disclosure credibility erodes incrementally, and the information risk stays alive. A similar volume spread once across many fields (low concentration) is the signature of a single broad cleanup sweep - a policy change or re-audit that retires uncertainty. The restatement literature ties targeted/intentional restatements to worse governance and worse consequences than wholesale corrections, and each individual amendment is low-salience, so the market separates the two geometries slowly or never. Concentrated-repetition filers therefore carry persistent information risk and an elevated death hazard that only a death-inclusive cohort measures honestly (1,023,812 of the 1,667,422 chain groups belong to DEAD_EVIDENCED entities per the P0 census; a survivor-only panel would censor exactly the short-leg mass). Critically, the signal uses only CHAIN GEOMETRY - group counts per field, depth, amend_count - never any corrected value.
mechanism.what_the_book_does: A per-sector net-zero tercile long-short on the death-inclusive cohort: short concentrated-repetition filers (high field-concentration of as-of chains), long broad-sweep filers (low concentration), quarterly decisions on the inherited 21-session grid, one grid step holding with rank hysteresis, exits at last close for dead legs, band-model costs charged exactly once per fill.
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: (i) the repetition geometry is efficiently priced: anchor expectancy <= 0 after base costs; (ii) the volume-and-cardinality-matched shuffled-chain control reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x same-sign alpha - then the spread follows amendment VOLUME or field-count breadth, not repetition geometry, and the shape reading is falsified; (iii) fewer than 2 of 3 folds positive or drop-one expectancy <= 0; (iv) any pre-selection identifiability or novelty gate fails - the proposal dies at D2 before any scored cell.
mechanism.which_control_kills_the_convenient_expla: The convenient explanation is 'concentration is just amendment volume in disguise - anyone with many amendments does badly'. The volume-and-cardinality-matched shuffled-chain control kills it: for each entity and decision date it preserves the group count N(e,t) AND the distinct field cardinality F(e,t) EXACTLY (depth and amend_count marginals intact per entity) and destroys only WHICH field each group repeats (fixed-seed field-label permutation, seed 20260907, re-drawn per decision date). If alpha follows volume or breadth, the control reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x same sign; if alpha follows repetition geometry, the control collapses toward zero. The control runs under evidenced semantics (P-3): it permutes evidenced group keys; nothing asserted, nothing imputed; it recomputes under any semantics change.

falsifiable_prediction: Within-sector chain-shape concentration predicts next-quarter relative returns: the high-concentration tercile (short) underperforms the low-concentration tercile (long) in at least 2 of 3 folds S0_FOLD_1/2/3 after band costs, with (a) anchor expectancy > 0; (b) position PF >= 1.10; (c) populated-fold PF >= 0.8; (d) risk-matched SPY-excess alpha > 0 overall and positive in >= 2 of 3 folds; (e) ETF positive share <= 0.50 (expected 0.00 - the book holds no ETF legs); (f) max fold MDD <= 0.15; (g) the volume-and-cardinality-matched control's |alpha| < 0.5x the anchor's alpha - same-sign reproduction at >= 0.5x kills the family; (h) the amend_count volume neighbour supports with same-sign alpha; (i) pre-selection gates R1-R5 pass at D2 before selection; (j) pooled Spearman |rho| <= 0.20 vs ALL eleven veto entries, measured at D2 before selection. Failure interpretations are preregistered in failure_interpretation - none is a tuning opportunity. Availability-lag mutation (P3 invariant): pushing any last_avail stamp later shifts the entity's exposure by at most one decision-grid step and changes nothing else; any larger shift is an implementation leak and the arm is NOT_RUN fail-closed.

universe.bookable_pool: ALIVE_EVIDENCED (410) + DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED (1550) legs of research/control/stocks_free_v9_run/cohort_v9.json (sha256 6a95401ff84bff2144ac3c0b9426a6fa86daf3dde8d478195666249e3fa2aa62), carried unchanged per the P3-frozen death_inclusive_universe; NOT_DEAD_PRICE_SURVIVAL (219) and GAP_COVERAGE (513) excluded-with-reasons and never bookable in any arm; no survivorship re-substitution: a dead leg is never replaced by a successor entity's series and exits at its last recorded close.
universe.eligibility_per_decision: bookable pool AND >= 63 price bars through the decision date (inherited floor) AND ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD (band C or better; UNTRADABLE excluded, L-I3 fail-closed) AND RAW close >= 1.00 USD AND |Q(e,t)| >= 4 qualifying chain groups (the P3-frozen min_hist own floor of 4; not tuned) AND the entity's frozen sector tag has >= 6 eligible ranked names, else that sector abstains the decision.
universe.sector_conditioning: frozen empirical SIC-to-SPDR majority map shipped in cohort_v9.json (sic_sector_map), carried unchanged; sector is the neutralizer, never the exposure.
universe.dead_leg_honesty: exit-at-last-close semantics carried from the V9/V10 P3 payloads; the exit cost path is resolve_exit_band_bps (own band when tradable, C-rate 25 bps ceiling when UNTRADABLE/missing), never the silent fallback (L-I3). The dead-leg chain mass (1,023,812 of 1,667,422 chain groups, P0 census) enters the conditioning mass honestly; the 4,270 zero-post-window arrival events do not bind these arms because the arms are conditioning books on the session grid, not arrival-window books.

cited_funded_clocks.observable: vintage-chain depth (chain groups per filer-period; max depth per filer)
cited_funded_clocks.use: anchor field-concentration HHI over as-of depth>=2 chain groups (group counts per field); the chain-group panel of this clock funds the geometry

cited_funded_clocks.observable: inter_arrival_days / amend_count (cadence of the amendment process)
cited_funded_clocks.use: neighbour median amend_count over as-of groups (process volume); the inter_arrival_days leg of this clock funds the H1 proposal, not this one's anchor

clock.conditioning_rule: amendment_process clock semantics (p2_v11_coverage_first.json clock_semantics, verbatim): 'chain-shape conditioners are available at the group's LAST vintage stamp (last_avail): depth, amend_count, inter_arrival_days - the PROCESS, never corrected values (direction/severity usage is ancestry-vetoed at D2)'. A decision at session t observes a group only if last_avail < gate(t), gate(t) = 00:00 UTC of the decision session; staleness bound 0 <= t - last_avail <= 800 days (max_age_days 800 everywhere; no unbounded variant). deadline_distance is DATA_BLOCKED_VALID and is never cited (P-1). V10-R1-REV-DIR and V10-R2-REV-MAG are not citable as signal inputs and enter no arm; no V10-T1/T2/T3 timing clock enters any arm; V11-E1-FILING-EVENT is not cited (no arrival-window book anywhere in this proposal).
clock.warmup_note: no own_norm/cohort_norm seeding required - the exposure is a raw Herfindahl of group counts read directly per as-of group set

warmup_rationale: the exposure reads evidenced group keys directly per depth>=2 chain group as of the decision (a Herfindahl of counts; no own/cohort norm seeding, no delta-of-levels legs - V8 F2 ratio-level precedent warmup 0); the grid's index-63 start already seeds the 63-bar and ADV63 eligibility floors; those floors are eligibility/cost machinery, not signal warmup.

decision_grid.schedule: inherited 21-session grid: sessions at indices 63+21k from each fold start (k = 0, 1, 2, ...), pure session-index schedule, no calendar anchoring; approximately 26-28 scored decisions per fold, >= 75 overall (exact counts fixed by the session grid before scoring).
decision_grid.no_finer_grid_rationale: no finer grid demanded and none declared: chain groups accrue at last_avail cadence (pooled inter-arrival p50 = 364 days per the funded clock), so a 21-session step cannot systematically sample inside a sub-step arrival, and the availability-lag mutation guarantees stamp shifts propagate by whole evidence stamps, not intra-grid timing.

entry_exit_fills.signal_semantics: signals computed on session t close data under last_avail < gate(t), gate(t) = 00:00 UTC of the decision session; fills at the next allowed session close (V3 ADJ-1-EXEC-CLOCK; no same-session fill).
entry_exit_fills.fill_check: a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; missing bar = the order does not exist (no silent substitute pricing).
entry_exit_fills.exit_at_last_close: a held name whose series ends is exited at its last recorded close on its final session (delisting-return leg carried by the price series itself; no synthetic penalty, no synthetic continuation); exit costs via resolve_exit_band_bps - C-rate ceiling when the band has become UNTRADABLE/missing, never the silent fallback (L-I3 fail-closed).
entry_exit_fills.holding: one grid step (21 trading sessions) with rank-hysteresis: a held name is retained until its rank exits its tercile band by more than one decile (effective holding 1-2 quarters); book forced flat at every fold boundary.
entry_exit_fills.portfolio_construction: per-sector net-zero long-short: within each sector tag with >= 6 eligible ranked names, long the bottom tercile and short the top tercile of the exposure (descending = short), equal-weight within legs, per-sector net zero; CASH absorbs residual; >= 1 non-CASH leg per decision; gross capped 2.0; all books reconcile to 1.0 within 1e-9. Tercile boundaries: midrank ties at a boundary join the lower (long) tercile - deterministic and conservative (the short leg is strictly the highest exposures). The book_form provision 2.1 is deliberately NOT invoked: the book holds cohort equities only (no SPY/sector-ETF legs), because per-sector net-zero construction already neutralizes sector exposure without paying ETF-leg costs and without diluting exit-at-last-close death-leg honesty.

costs.model: inherited band model, charged exactly once per fill, linear in fills, applied to BOOKED PnL, no sidecar: research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py verbatim - BAND_BPS = {"A": 10.0, "B": 15.0, "C": 25.0}; band_of: ADV63 >= 50,000,000 -> A, >= 10,000,000 -> B, >= 2,000,000 -> C, else UNTRADABLE; fill_cost_bps = abs(dw) * resolve_band_bps(name, bands) * cost_mult / 10_000.0.
costs.fail_closed: a traded name without a computed band at costing raises BandResolutionError - the silent 10 bps fallback is forbidden (L-I3); an entry never reaches costing with an UNTRADABLE band; exits of held names use resolve_exit_band_bps (own band when tradable, C-rate 25 bps ceiling when UNTRADABLE/missing).
costs.stress: stress rerun is cost_mult 2.0 (20/30/50 bps per side) applied to booked PnL; reported alongside base.
costs.expected_blend: the dead leg skews to lower dollar volume, so the blended base cost is expected between 15 and 25 bps per side; fills, cost and booked PnL reported split by band for base AND stress.

arms.arms_note: exactly three arms per binding rule - anchor, neighbour, control; every other key in this object is a note, not an arm. All arms RUN under evidenced semantics (P-3): every input row is a staged depth>=2 chain group with a recorded last_avail stamp; no asserted timestamps anywhere (P-1); each arm is testable under the P3 availability-lag mutation; the control recomputes under any semantics change.
arms.anchor: chain-shape concentration exposure: hhi(e,t) = sum_f (n_f(e,t) / N(e,t))^2 where n_f(e,t) counts the as-of chain groups of entity e on field f and N(e,t) = |Q(e,t)| (formula in exposure_definition), per-sector long-low/short-high terciles. Claim: filers whose amendment activity repeats on the same few fields (targeted repetition = unresolved recurring problem) underperform filers whose similar amendment volume sweeps broadly across fields (one-time cleanup).
arms.neighbour: process-volume median (required SUPPORT, same sign): vol_med(e,t) = median of amend_count(g) over g in Q(e,t) under V11-E3-AMEND-CADENCE. More amendment volume per chain means deeper compelled re-work; under the repetition-strain reading it must load the SAME direction as concentration (high volume -> short side by the shared long-low/short-high convention). If vol_med carries the opposite sign, the repetition-strain interpretation is withdrawn (declared support-failure, not a tuning opportunity).
arms.control: volume-and-cardinality-matched shuffled-chain falsification control (geometry-null): for each entity e and decision date t, keep the multiset of group counts N(e,t) and the distinct field-label set F(e,t) EXACTLY, and permute each group's field label uniformly over F(e,t) (numpy PCG64 seed 20260907, permutation applied to the group-key-sorted index vector, re-drawn per decision date in session-index order - fully deterministic and frozen); recompute HHI on the permuted labels and run the IDENTICAL per-sector tercile machinery. N and F marginals are preserved per entity (depth and amend_count marginals intact), so every volume/breadth artifact survives; only the repetition geometry is destroyed. Kill rule: control |alpha| >= 0.5x anchor |alpha| with the same sign -> the spread follows amendment volume or field-count breadth, not repetition geometry -> the family is falsified per the falsification-by-control cluster (RULES section 2.3).
arms.intended_correlation_profile_and_why_it_: anchor vs control: after label shuffling, control HHI is near-deterministic in (N, F) (the expected HHI of a uniform random partition), so control ranks correlate with the anchor only through volume and cardinality - declared expected pooled Spearman rho 0.2-0.5, gate 0.70 (pre_selection_identifiability_check R1). The control's discriminating power: if the anchor's alpha survives when geometry is randomized away, geometry was never the driver - volume was. Correlation declared ex ante, measured at D2 before selection, never argued post hoc.

exposure_definition: At each decision date t (session gate g(t) = 00:00 UTC of session t), for entity e: Q(e,t) = { (f, p) chain groups of e in the staged v10_timing_observables.jsonl layer (sha256 b1477ea39b8b794b7f32162cb349ff53fdd1a37b9a64d0ee20e77412ae802337; depth>=2 filer-field-period rows, joined where needed to the revision layer's last_avail stamps) satisfying last_avail(g) < g(t) and 0 <= t - last_avail(g) <= 800 days }, with N(e,t) = |Q(e,t)| >= 4 (entities below the floor ineligible, not zero-ranked). Exposure value: hhi(e,t) = sum over fields f present in Q(e,t) of ( n_f(e,t) / N(e,t) )^2, where n_f(e,t) = |{g in Q(e,t) : field(g) = f}|. Field labels enter as CHAIN KEYS only - no field value, level, or change is ever read. Ranking direction: descending hhi = short side (concentrated repetition), ascending = long side (broad sweep). Normalization: none beyond the Herfindahl (raw value used for ranking AND for the D2 veto measurement - the within-sector tercile standardization applied for trading is monotone within sector and the veto is measured on the raw pooled rank, midrank ties, the conservative choice). Inputs: group keys (entity, field, period), depth, last_avail, amend_count (neighbour only); no price, no level ratio, no delta-of-levels, no corrected value, no direction, no magnitude. The same formula, evaluated on the same cohort and frozen decision dates, is what D2 ranks against each veto entry (Spearman, midrank ties, pooled).

pre_selection_identifiability_check.purpose: the V8 a5 lesson: control identifiability and anchor non-vacuity must be measurable BEFORE selection, from data alone, no PnL in existence.
pre_selection_identifiability_check.rule: On every frozen decision date t over S0_FOLD_1/2/3, over the pre-check universe = bookable-pool names with >= 63 price bars through t (bar counts from the sha-pinned staged price bars; NO band computation, NO returns): (R1) RANK GATE - pooled |mean Spearman rho| between the anchor rank vector and the geometry-null control rank vector <= 0.70, and per-date rho <= 0.70 on >= 90% of dates (declared expected band 0.2-0.5: post-shuffle HHI is near-deterministic in (N, F), so ranks correlate through volume/cardinality - the gate certifies the permutation ran and that geometry, not (N,F) alone, is what differs); (R2) CONTROL NON-DEGENERACY - by exact marginal preservation (N, F per entity) the control terciles populate with the anchor's own counts; measured anyway: both control terciles contain >= 6 names on >= 90% of dates; (R3) ANCHOR COVERAGE - the anchor rank is populated on >= 60% of the measured universe on >= 90% of dates; (R4) ANCHOR DISPERSION - the pooled interquartile range of hhi across the measured universe is >= 0.05 (a collapsed dispersion would make the tercile book tie-mass; declared now, measurable from PIT alone); (R5) SECTOR PARTICIPATION - on >= 90% of dates, >= 60% of the measured universe sits in sectors passing the >= 6-name rule (else the book is too abstaining to trade). Any gate failure blocks the proposal BEFORE selection (INELIGIBLE_CONTROL_UNIDENTIFIABLE / INELIGIBLE_VACUOUS_CONTROL / INELIGIBLE_BOOK_UNPOPULATED, fail-closed, V4 + V8 a5 precedent); the check runs at D2 alongside novelty and its bytes are published before any scored cell.
pre_selection_identifiability_check.inputs: the staged timing/revision observable layers under the cited clocks + staged price bar availability ONLY; no ADV, no cost model, no returns - nothing scored exists at measurement time.

incremental_alpha_test.vs_SPY: incremental alpha = arm return minus risk-matched SPY context (SPY scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen gross/vol rule per the P3-carried factor/benchmark protocol), per fold and overall; require excess positive in >= 2 of 3 folds AND overall SPY-excess alpha > 0 (SPY-excess positivity declared here, binding at scoring); raw PnL or long-equity beta is never accepted as alpha.
incremental_alpha_test.vs_sector_ETF: same test against the equal-weight mapped sector-ETF factor (SPY + 11 SPDR sector files, verified-by-pin); the book is per-sector net zero so residual sector drift appears as reported tracking error, not alpha.
incremental_alpha_test.etf_share_gate: ETF positive share <= 0.50 where ETF legs exist; this book declares NO ETF legs (2.1 provision not invoked), so the measured share is expected 0.00 with the gate binding only if an implementation path ever introduced ETF legs.
incremental_alpha_test.stage_a_gates_applied_with_no_relaxation: expectancy > 0; position PF >= 1.1; folds positive >= 2; populated-fold PF >= 0.8; max fold MDD <= 0.15; ETF positive share <= 0.50; fold positive share <= 0.5; anchor overall SPY-excess alpha > 0; control |alpha| ratio < 0.5; neighbour same-sign support required; margin-to-fail reported for every gate on a survivor (P-2); reproduction ALL_MATCH from a detached tree.

turnover_and_sample_floor.decisions_total: >= 30 scored decision periods overall (declared grid approx. 78); >= 5 per fold.
turnover_and_sample_floor.turnover_convention: turnover = sum(abs(delta_weight)) over non-CASH legs (V3 ADJ-5 corrected); annualized two-way with hysteresis expected below the 6.0/year ceiling; raw and ceiling-normalized reported.
turnover_and_sample_floor.floor_mechanics: min 5 decision periods per fold; min 1 non-CASH leg per decision; CASH excluded from turnover, concentration and drop-one; force-flat at fold boundaries.

drop_one_design: drop-one-symbol: rerun excluding the max-contribution symbol; survival requires after-drop expectancy > 0 (dead-leg names are legitimate exclusions; the max contributor may be a dying name - that is a legitimate drop, not a special case).
drop-one-fold: min over folds of expectancy with that fold removed; survival requires min > 0.

drop-one-shape-leg: recompute hhi over only entities with >= 8 as-of chain groups (more reliable concentration estimates; the P3-frozen |Q| >= 4 floor is retained for the anchor, this leg tightens its own floor to 8 as a declared robustness cut, not a search); survival requires sign preservation and expectancy > 0; if the premium exists only among thin-count entities where HHI is noisy, the geometry reading is withdrawn.

margin_to_fail_expectations.note: declared BEFORE any scored PnL exists, per P-2; anticipations, not thresholds - the binding thresholds are the frozen gate list and nothing here relaxes them.
margin_to_fail_expectations.expectancy_gt_0: MOST LIKELY BINDING GATE: 10-25 bps per side on a quarterly book whose short leg concentrates repetition-heavy, often low-ADV names; the anticipated margin is small and positive if the channel is real, and the stress rerun (2x) is expected to consume roughly half of it.
margin_to_fail_expectations.position_pf_ge_1.1: second-most-likely binding; a low-salience geometry channel is expected to produce PF in the 1.05-1.25 band if real; thin margin declared ex ante.
margin_to_fail_expectations.folds_positive_ge_2_and_fold_positive_sh: S0_FOLD_1 (2018-04..2020-09) is the anticipated weak fold: the Feb-Mar 2020 terminal event realizes the short side violently, then mean-reverts inside the hysteresis holding window; declared risk is fold-1-negative / folds-2-3-positive, which still passes the >= 2 gate.
margin_to_fail_expectations.max_fold_mdd_le_0.15: expected to pass with margin for a per-sector net-zero book at gross <= 2.0; tail risk is death clustering on the short leg inside one sector-quarter, only partially capped by the 63-bar/band floors.
margin_to_fail_expectations.etf_positive_share_le_0.50: expected 0.00 by no-ETF-leg construction; full margin declared.
margin_to_fail_expectations.spy_excess_and_sector_etf_alpha: the specificity-of-information gates: expected positive if and only if the repetition-geometry channel carries information beyond market/sector context; the V10 sector-drowning lesson (ETF-share 0.8333, SPY-excess 0/3) is the failure mode this family's net-zero construction is built to avoid, not a guarantee.
margin_to_fail_expectations.control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt_0.5: THE FALSIFICATION GATE: expected to pass if and only if repetition geometry (not amendment volume or field-count breadth) carries the spread; the R1-R5 pre-selection gates exist precisely so this comparison is meaningful if reached.
margin_to_fail_expectations.novelty_pooled_rho_le_0.20: expected 0.00-0.10 given process-only inputs (no price, no value, no direction); a fail dies at D2 before any scored cell - the cheap death.
margin_to_fail_expectations.margin_to_fail_reporting: at scoring, every gate reports its distance to the failure threshold; a survivor reporting knife-edge margins (< 0.05 PF margin, < 25% of MDD headroom) is treated as thin-margin class per P-2 regardless of pass count.

failure_interpretation.anchor_expectancy_le_0: the repetition geometry is already efficiently priced on this cohort or does not transmit to relative returns - withdraw the family; no rescue variant (REJECT is a successful outcome).
failure_interpretation.control_ratio_ge_0.5_same_sign: the spread follows amendment volume or field-count breadth, not repetition geometry - the chain-SHAPE reading is falsified and the family dies; this is the pre-declared falsification outcome and a successful test (falsification-by-control cluster precedent).
failure_interpretation.neighbour_opposite_sign: the geometry reading is not coherent with process volume - withdraw the repetition-strain interpretation (support-failure, not a tuning opportunity).
failure_interpretation.folds_positive_lt_2_or_fold_positive_sha: the effect does not survive regime change - die.
failure_interpretation.spy_excess_fail: the spread is market/sector context, not incremental information - die (the measured V10 sector-drowning lesson applied to this family).
failure_interpretation.etf_share_gt_0.50: sector leakage through the book construction - die.
failure_interpretation.populated_fold_pf_lt_0.8: the book degrades to noise in some regime - die.
failure_interpretation.pre_selection_gate_fail_R1_R5: die at D2 before any scored cell (INELIGIBLE_*); the design never reaches PnL - the cheap death, correctly taken.
failure_interpretation.novelty_fail: the process conditioning is a hedged relabelling of a vetoed ancestor - die at D2; measured, never argued.
failure_interpretation.availability_lag_mutation_fail: implementation leak - the arm is NOT_RUN fail-closed; no repair after PnL is visible.
failure_interpretation.thin_margin_rule: a survivor with knife-edge margins (< 0.05 PF margin, < 25% MDD headroom) is reported thin per P-2 regardless of pass count and is treated as candidate-not-edge.

frozen_thresholds.hhi_form: sum_f (n_f / N)^2 over as-of chain-group fields
frozen_thresholds.terciles: long bottom / short top; boundary ties join the long tercile
frozen_thresholds.hysteresis: retain until rank exits tercile band by more than one decile

no_parameter_grid_declaration: No parameter grid exists anywhere in this proposal: every constant in frozen_thresholds is single-valued and frozen at wave SHA ea668797b661dfa2c9d2b2799e46fe0f13f71820 before any scored outcome exists. The HHI form is a single closed formula with no free parameter; the drop-one-shape-leg floor of 8 is a declared robustness cut written before any PnL, not a scanned alternative; the permutation seed is a fixed integer; terciles, hysteresis, gross cap, grid, floors and gates are inherited single-valued conventions. No scan over concentration forms, floors, quantiles, seeds, universes or thresholds is declared or permitted; any post-PnL change to any constant is rescue and is forbidden.

novelty_declaration.novelty_standard: measured decorrelation pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs every one of the eleven veto entries, measured at D2 BEFORE selection on the raw exposure rank (Spearman, midrank ties, pooled over the frozen decision dates and cohort) - never prose; the exposure formula above is written so D2 can compute the rank correlation directly.
novelty_declaration.momentum_incl_V2_ETF_relative: CLEAN BY INPUT DISJOINTNESS - no price series, return, or lagged-return quantity enters any exposure; the only price-derived quantities are the 63-bar floor, ADV63 band eligibility and the >= 1.00 price floor, all sanctioned eligibility/cost machinery, not signals. D2 gate: pooled |rho| <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.semivariance: CLEAN - no variance, semivariance, or OHLC-derived shape quantity anywhere. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.vol_level: CLEAN - no vol-level, band-of-vol, or range quantity. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.WC_stock_intensity: CLEAN BY CONSTRUCTION - no working-capital level, stock, or intensity is computed; field labels appear only as chain keys inside a count Herfindahl, never as values or value changes. D2 gate <= 0.20 (measured, never argued).
novelty_declaration.Goodwill_bloat: CLEAN - no Goodwill and no Assets quantity enters any arm. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.F1_accrual_flow: CLEAN - no accrual flow composite, no delta-of-levels; the exposure lives entirely on chain-group counts. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.depletion_runway_interaction: CLEAN - no (delta-RE, Cash, Assets) construction and no interaction form of any rejected family. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.cash_level_shadow: CLEAN - no cash or asset level enters any arm. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.sector_exposure_form: CLEAN BY DESIGN - per-sector net-zero book; sector is the neutralizer, not the exposure; the ETF-share gate and the SPY/sector-ETF incremental-alpha tests cover the long-beta masquerade (V4 participation lesson). D2 gate <= 0.20 on the raw exposure rank.
novelty_declaration.v10_deseasonalized_timing_own_z: DIFFERENT LAYER AND STATISTIC - own_z was a TIMING-axis characteristic: first-vintage filing lag standardized by the entity's own history (V10-T2, first_avail semantics, deseasonalized). H2 is a REVISION-axis geometry characteristic: an unstandardized Herfindahl of chain-group counts across fields under last_avail semantics, with no z-score, no own-history standardization, and no first-vintage lag anywhere. D2 gate <= 0.20 measured on the raw hhi rank.
novelty_declaration.v10_revision_correction_direction_breadt: PROCESS, NOT VALUE - addressed head-on. The vetoed V10 A5-H1 exposure was down-incidence breadth: the share of groups whose corrected VALUE moved DOWN (rev_dir), with severity (rev_mag) as neighbour - both dead per the frozen V10 terminal, and their USAGE FORMS are veto entries. H2 never reads a corrected value, a direction, or a magnitude: hhi counts HOW REPEATEDLY the same fields' chains recur - incidence-of-DIRECTION vs GEOMETRY-of-REPETITION, value content vs process shape.
